name: recruit-job-description
description: Writes an outcomes-first job description from the job scorecard, with must-haves only, a pay range line, an adjustments line and a wording check that flags gendered, age-coded and exclusionary words. Use for "run recruit-job-description", "write a job description", "rewrite this JD", "job description from scorecard", "check my job description for biased wording", "gender neutral job description", "our JD attracts the wrong applicants", "update last year's job description", part of the AI for Recruiting Pack by 90n.
